title: Repair of Electric Scooters for Recycling and Refurbishment

information.value: Resoldering battery connections / Replacing fuses and MOSFETs on motherboards / Repairing severed motor cables / Replacing controllers on UrbanGlide scooters / Resolving vibration issues caused by solid tires
Give a second life to electric scooters recovered for parts / Reduce electronic waste / Develop skills in power electronics and light electric vehicle maintenance

description: I regularly repair electric scooters recovered mainly from LeBonCoin, often given away for parts. This personal project is part of an initiative focused on repair and recycling, bringing devices considered irreparable back to life.
In most cases, the issue stems from battery solder joints breaking due to vibrations caused by solid tire usage. Road conditions amplify these vibrations, leading to electrical connection failures.

Beyond these common issues, I have also tackled more complex problems. Notably, I replaced a fuse and MOSFETs on the motherboard of a Xiaomi scooter after identifying that the root cause was a severed motor cable, which I resoldered inside the motor. This damaged cable caused the short circuit that led to the motherboard failure.
I also performed complete controller replacements on UrbanGlide scooter models, restoring them to optimal working condition.

This project has allowed me to strengthen my skills in power electronics, fault diagnostics, electric motor repairs, and light electric vehicle maintenance, while contributing to the reduction of electronic waste.
